page.layout: One printed page, a digitiser's cover sheet. Top right: publisher logo. Centre: title block (website name, book title, author, place and date, library, persistent link). Lower half: two blocks of multilingual terms of use, separated by rules. Bottom right: a logo.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara logo, title block, multilingual terms of use and Visual Library logo). Not part of the printed book, so no text is transcribed. The printed book's title, "Diatriba de intellectu humano" (Lucius, Ludwig; Basileae, [ca. 1640]), is taken from this sheet only for orientation and does not appear as text on the page.
